description: Source code for a Zephyr driver for Microchip XEC EEPROM, including register definitions, read/write operations, power management, and device initialization.

methods.name: eeprom_xec_execute_reg_set
methods.description: Sets the execute register with command, transfer size, and EEPROM address.

methods.name: eeprom_xec_data_buffer_read
methods.description: Reads data from EEPROM buffer into destination buffer.

methods.name: eeprom_xec_data_buffer_write
methods.description: Writes data from source buffer into EEPROM buffer.

methods.name: eeprom_xec_wait_transfer_compl
methods.description: Waits for EEPROM transfer to complete with retries.

methods.name: eeprom_xec_wait_write_compl
methods.description: Waits for EEPROM write operation to complete.

methods.name: eeprom_xec_data_read_32_bytes
methods.description: Performs a 32-byte read from EEPROM at specified offset.

methods.name: eeprom_xec_data_write_32_bytes
methods.description: Performs a 32-byte write to EEPROM at specified offset.

methods.name: eeprom_xec_pm_action
methods.description: Handles power management actions for EEPROM device.
